title: NHS Education for Scotland — Health Workforce Development & Digital Learning AI Deep-Dive Governance Pack
description: 12-entry-point AI governance framework for NHS Education for Scotland (NES) — the national body for NHS Scotland education, training, and workforce development — covering medical training, nursing & midwifery, pharmacy, dental, AHP, psychology, healthcare science, digital learning (Turas), leadership, public health, remote & rural healthcare, and workforce intelligence. Red lines: no AI-sole training assessment decisions; no automated processing of trainee special-category health data.
